editorial:
Imagine trying to be a great dad and a godly man while also being a professional killer for the mob. That is the wild spot Latif finds himself in. You get to follow him through the streets of Houston as he deals with the heartbreaking loss of his wife and the terrifying reality that his two worlds are crashing together. It feels like a high-stakes road trip where the car is always under fire and the emotional weight is just as heavy as the gunfire. You will really feel for Latif as he tries to keep his kids safe while wondering if he can ever truly be forgiven for what he does for a living.

The action is punchy and the acting makes you actually care about this broken family. While some parts of the middle feel a bit slow, the tension builds up to a crazy finish that keeps you glued to your seat. If you love stories about fathers protecting their kids, you need to see this. For the best experience, you should stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the gritty detail, or just rent it on Apple TV for a movie night. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your shelf is a great move.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Latif discovers that his own boss ordered the hit on his wife to keep him under control. After a brutal fight in a rainy alley, Latif kills his former employer to ensure his children are safe. He chooses to leave the life of crime behind forever. The movie ends with him taking his kids far away from Houston to start over, finally finding peace with his faith and his family.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves action movies with a lot of heart and family drama.
